panel_description_zh: 中景平视，李斌坐在沙发另一头；表情无语 + 微微抬头（他在尝试为闺蜜说话）；嘴微张；脸 3/4 侧面。
prompt_en: Chinese modern comic style, contemporary urban realism, soft cinematic lighting, naturalistic proportions. Eye-level medium shot of the 30-something East Asian Chinese husband sitting on the other end of the grey fabric sofa, his body angled slightly toward his wife but his head tilted forward just a degree. Speechless exasperated expression with a slight attempt at speech — eyes half-lidded looking toward the wife's direction, eyebrows flat but the inner ends just barely lifted, mouth slightly open mid-speech with a tiny breath between the lips, dark circles under the eyes, clean-shaven jaw with no stubble, short black slightly messy side-swept hair. Wearing a loose grey cotton crew-neck t-shirt and navy blue plaid pajama pants. The plastic snack bag sits between them on the sofa. Warm yellow-white living room light. Mood: the rare moment he opens his mouth to defend someone else, immediately regretted. Text watermark 'P13-PN04' in the bottom-right corner.
negative_prompt_en: anime proportions, fully open alert eyes, smiling, wife visible in the frame, decorative hallway art, daylight from a window, second character, friend/girlfriend character visible, romantic soft lighting, exaggerated cartoonish sweat drops, dramatic shadows
